metrics.name: Demand rate now (orders per week)
metrics.description: The OU-evolving arrival rate lambda(t). Its mean is demand_mu; excursions are the SDE at work.

metrics.name: Backlog (orders waiting)
metrics.description: Customer orders received and not yet fulfilled or cancelled.

metrics.name: Orders fulfilled
metrics.description: KPI: sales completed within the horizon. Scope note (review Option A): demand is all-site sales served from site 1000; this measures whether the plant supplies the network, not final customer delivery.

metrics.name: Sum of fulfilment lead times (weeks)
metrics.description: Sum of `waited` at fulfilment. Average lead time = this / orders fulfilled (division done outside: 1 reduce per metric, DSL limit).

metrics.name: Lost sales (spot orders cancelled)
metrics.description: KPI: spot orders cancelled (count). Lost UNITS are the companion metric.

metrics.name: Raw stock on shelf, Sonaflozin (units)
metrics.description: Sum of stock qty on the shelf.

metrics.name: Raw stock on shelf, Flowbind Material (units)
metrics.description: Sum of stock qty on the shelf.

metrics.name: Stock in transit (units)
metrics.description: Sum of stock qty in transit, all vendors.

metrics.name: Finished goods, Sonic Flow (units)
metrics.description: Sum of stock qty in the finished store.

metrics.name: Expired stock written off (units)
metrics.description: KPI: qty lost to shelf-life expiry, raw and finished. Per-material split via kind in the verifier.

metrics.name: Batches scrapped (QC)
metrics.description: KPI: rare-event branch; 1,000 units of product each.

metrics.name: Purchase orders placed
metrics.description: All vendors.

metrics.name: Purchase spend (EUR)
metrics.description: Committed on placed orders at the price CAPTURED at order time (recorded eina/eine unit prices scaled by the OU price index). Switching fees are a separate metric.

metrics.name: Supplier switches (substitute orders)
metrics.description: KPI: 2,500-unit Flowbind Material orders redirected to German supplier while Indian supplier was out of stock.

metrics.name: Shipments lost in transit
metrics.description: KPI: consignments lost in transit. The vendor reships a replacement batch (fresh dispatch leg + mean transit leg, full shelf life — the lost goods are physically gone), so a loss costs lead time, not money; the replacement keeps the order-time price.

metrics.name: Reshipped consignment value (EUR)
metrics.description: Value of consignments lost and reshipped, at the order-time price. Not a write-off: the vendor honours the order, so the cost of a loss is the extra lead time, not the money.

metrics.name: Switching fees (EUR)
metrics.description: Cost of redirecting orders (switch_cost per substitute order). Total purchasing cost = spend + this (added in the harness: 1 reduce per metric, DSL limit).

metrics.name: Conservation component: Sonaflozin in-transit units
metrics.description: Harness input: material conservation needs several sums (shelf + in transit + consumed + expired = initial + ordered); the DSL allows 1 reduce per metric, so the verifier assembles the identity from component metrics.

metrics.name: Orders fulfilled (contract)
metrics.description: Split of fulfilled orders by segment colour.

metrics.name: Contract tardiness (order-weeks)
metrics.description: Sum over fulfilled contract orders of max(0, waited - delivery window). Demand is conserved for contracts; lateness costs money instead of orders.

metrics.name: Late-delivery penalties (EUR)
metrics.description: Contract tardiness priced at late_penalty_per_week. Composes with purchase spend and switching fees into one cost objective.

metrics.name: Shipments delayed (cumulative)
metrics.description: KPI: shipments that hit a customs / goods-receipt hold. The stock keeps ageing while held and is released to its shelf on the slow timescale; it cannot be lost while held (losses fire on OnOrder only — simplification).

metrics.name: Units held up in delayed shipments
metrics.description: Current qty sitting in the hold, still ageing.

metrics.name: Raw material price index (now)
metrics.description: The OU-evolving multiplier on the recorded eina unit prices. Mean 1.0; excursions are the price SDE at work.

metrics.name: Stock at vendor, not yet shipped (units)
metrics.description: Order book: accepted orders awaiting dispatch. A vendor outage stalls this place (Ship holds the InStock token); it no longer stalls the transit pipe.

metrics.name: Conservation component: Sonaflozin at-vendor units
metrics.description: Harness input, as the in-transit component.

metrics.name: Holding costs banked (EUR)
metrics.description: Storage cost accrued by stock that has since been discarded or written off. Total holding cost = this + the 3 live-accrual metrics (summed in the harness: 1 reduce per metric, DSL limit).

metrics.name: Holding cost accrued, Sonaflozin shelf (EUR)
metrics.description: Live accrual on stock currently stored.

metrics.name: Holding cost accrued, Flowbind Material shelf (EUR)
metrics.description: Live accrual on stock currently stored.

metrics.name: Holding cost accrued, Sonic Flow store (EUR)
metrics.description: Live accrual on stock currently stored.

metrics.name: Units sold
metrics.description: Sum of fulfilled order quantities (fitted vbap sizes).

metrics.name: Units lost (spot cancellations)
metrics.description: Demand that walked, in units — the volume the lost-margin costing of review change 4 will price.

metrics.name: Backlog (units waiting)
metrics.description: Open demand in units. Order qty is clamped >= 5 once, at arrival, so this reads it raw.

metrics.name: Scheduled batches waiting
metrics.description: afko-cadence production orders not yet started — rises when materials starve the plan.

metrics.name: Inventory position, Sonaflozin (units)
metrics.description: on-hand + at-vendor + in-transit − committed; quarantined/rejected/recalled/expired excluded. The reorder-point policy's decision variable.

metrics.name: Inventory position, Flowbind Material (units)
metrics.description: As the Sonaflozin position.

metrics.name: Stock in quarantine (units)
metrics.description: Delivered but not yet quality-released — unavailable to production and excluded from the inventory position.

metrics.name: QC-rejected stock (units)
metrics.description: Receipts that failed inspection (assumed ~5%).

metrics.name: Recalled stock (units)
metrics.description: Stock pulled by recall events (Recall wave scenario).

metrics.name: Disposal costs (EUR)
metrics.description: Controlled destruction + admin on expiry, QC rejection and recalls, at the assumed EUR 1.5/unit. Excludes the sunk purchase spend and holding already counted elsewhere.

metrics.name: Lost margin, cancelled spot (EUR)
metrics.description: Lost units x contribution margin (vbap NETPR - mbew STPRS = EUR 55.47/unit).

metrics.name: Production delay cost, banked (EUR)
metrics.description: waited x qty x rate charged when a late scheduled batch finally starts.

metrics.name: Production delay cost, accruing (EUR)
metrics.description: The same charge accruing on batches still waiting for materials. Total shortage cost = banked + this.
metrics.code: return state.places["ProductionOrdersWaiting"].tokens.reduce((n, t) => n + t.waited * t.produce_qty * parameters.shortage_cost_rate, 0);

metrics.name: Policy cost (EUR)
metrics.description: The single objective for the optimiser: purchase spend + holding (banked + still accruing on live stock, quarantine included) + lost margin on cancelled spot + production delay (banked + accruing) + late-delivery penalties + switching fees + disposal. Equals the sum of the component metrics by construction.
metrics.code: return state.places["OrdersPlaced"].tokens.reduce((n, t) => n + t.qty * t.unit_price, state.places["HoldingCosts"].tokens.concat(state.places["SwitchFees"].tokens).concat(state.places["DisposalCosts"].tokens).concat(state.places["ShortageCosts"].tokens).reduce((m, t) => m + t.value, state.places["LostSales"].tokens.reduce((l, t) => l + t.value * parameters.unit_margin, state.places["FulfilledOrders"].tokens.reduce((f, t) => f + t.tardiness * parameters.late_penalty_per_week, state.places["ProductionOrdersWaiting"].tokens.reduce((s, t) => s + t.waited * t.produce_qty * parameters.shortage_cost_rate, state.places["SonaflozinStock"].tokens.concat(state.places["FlowbindMaterialStock"].tokens).concat(state.places["FinishedGoods"].tokens).concat(state.places["Quarantine"].tokens).reduce((h, c) => h + c.holding_eur, 0))))));

metrics.name: Fill rate (sold / demanded units)
metrics.description: Units sold over all demanded units — sold + cancelled + still in the backlog — so a policy cannot look cheap by under-buying and failing customers. Division happens in a callback over the singleton DemandOutlook token (operand-position arithmetic around a reduce miscompiles); the 0.001 seed only guards the t=0 division. Scope note (review Option A): measures site 1000 supplying the network, not final customer delivery.
metrics.code: return state.places["DemandOutlook"].tokens.reduce((ratio, d) => state.places["FulfilledOrders"].tokens.reduce((s, t) => s + t.qty, 0) / ratio, state.places["FulfilledOrders"].tokens.reduce((a, t) => a + t.qty, state.places["LostSales"].tokens.reduce((b, t) => b + t.value, state.places["Backlog"].tokens.reduce((c, t) => c + t.qty, 0.001))));

scenarios.description: Stock as recorded: Sonaflozin as its 3 mcha batches with their real remaining lives (88/140/156 weeks); Flowbind Material as 1 stock token (mbew total; no batch rows exist, so its shelf life is the ASSUMED 156 weeks); finished Sonic Flow 4,273 units expiring in 28.5 weeks (mcha). Demand starts at its mean, 4.44/week.
